name: agent-workbench
description: 本地个人统一工作台 —— 一条命令起全栈（前端 5280 + daemon 5281）

scripts.dev: node electron/ensure-ports.cjs 5281 5280 && concurrently -k -n web,daemon -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -C prototype dev" "pnpm -C backend dev"
scripts.dev:desktop: node electron/ensure-ports.cjs 5281 5280 && concurrently -k -n web,daemon,desktop -c cyan,magenta,green "pnpm -C prototype dev" "pnpm -C backend dev" "node electron/wait-and-launch.cjs"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C prototype typecheck && pnpm -C backend typecheck
